description: Evaluation cases for the buy-cycles skill. Tests whether agents drive a card purchase of cycles for the CLI's own identity through the on-chain gateway: quote before create, own-account destination, verbatim URL hand-off to the human, polling until delivered, handling tooManyOpenOrders / quoteChanged / buyerNotAllowed / paid / needsReview, and continuing the deploy as the same identity.

output_evals.name: Core purchase flow
output_evals.prompt: My icp deploy to mainnet failed because my identity has no cycles and I have no ICP, just a credit card. Give me just the commands to buy about $10 of cycles for my current icp identity and then deploy. Do not run anything.
expected_behaviors: Uses `icp cycles buy --usd 10 -n ic` (or, as a fallback for older CLIs, `icp canister call saz2a-riaaa-aaaay-aadha-cai create_order …`), not `icp cycles mint` and not an exchange
Says the payment URL must be shown to the user to open on any device and that the agent does not pay
Uses the same identity for the purchase and for `icp deploy -e ic`
Does not suggest sending the cycles to a canister as the destination of the purchase

output_evals.name: Fallback destination and pin
output_evals.prompt: The installed icp CLI has no `cycles buy` subcommand. Show me just the `icp canister call` for create_order against the CyclePay gateway for $10, with the destination and the minCycles argument filled in correctly. No explanation of the rest of the flow.
expected_behaviors: Destination is `variant { cyclesLedgerAccount = record { owner = principal "<caller>"; subaccount = null } }` with the caller's own principal and a null subaccount
Passes an `opt` minCycles derived from a prior quote_previews call rather than null or an invented number

output_evals.name: URL parsing pitfall
output_evals.prompt: I'm writing a bash one-liner to pull the Stripe checkout URL out of the Candid text that `icp canister call … create_order` prints. What should I be careful about? Just the gotcha and a correct extraction, no full script.
expected_behaviors: Warns that stripping underscores (used by Candid as digit separators) corrupts the URL (cs_test_… → cstesta…)
Extracts the quoted string after `stripeSessionUrl = opt` unchanged
Mentions preferring `--json` output from `icp cycles buy` when available

output_evals.name: tooManyOpenOrders handling
output_evals.prompt: create_order on the cycles gateway returned `err = variant { notAdmitted = variant { tooManyOpenOrders = … } }`. What should I do next? One short answer.
expected_behaviors: Explains the cap is one open order per principal
Says to find/resume the existing `created` order or cancel it with cancel_order, not to retry create_order in a loop

output_evals.name: paid and needsReview states
output_evals.prompt: I bought cycles through the gateway; the order has said `paid` for two minutes, and a colleague's order says `needsReview`. Should I create new orders? Short answer.
expected_behaviors: Says no for `paid`: the card was charged and the gateway is retrying the ledger transfer
Says `needsReview` needs a gateway operator; report the order id and the charge, do not retry
Does not suggest creating a replacement order in either case

output_evals.name: Simulation allow-list
output_evals.prompt: The gateway refused my purchase with `notAdmitted(buyerNotAllowed)`. What does that mean and can I fix it myself? Two sentences.
expected_behaviors: Explains the gateway is in simulation mode and sells only to allow-listed principals
Says the buyer cannot fix it; a gateway controller must allow-list the principal, which the agent should name

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly. 'should_trigger' queries should cause the skill to load; 'should_not_trigger' queries should NOT activate this skill.
should_trigger: I have no ICP, how do I pay for cycles with a credit card?
icp deploy says insufficient cycles and I don't have a wallet. Can I just buy some?
Buy $20 of cycles for my icp identity with Stripe
What does icp cycles buy do?
Fund my CLI identity with cycles using a card so the agent can deploy
How do I get cycles without an exchange account?
The cycles gateway returned quoteChanged, what now?
should_not_trigger: Convert 2 ICP to cycles with icp cycles mint
Top up my canister from my existing cycles balance
How do I check my canister's cycle balance?
Add Stripe payments to my own dapp's frontend
Sign in to the NNS dapp from the terminal with Internet Identity
Set a freezing threshold on my canister
Transfer cycles between two of my identities
